basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old baking enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a graphic designer, but I spend my evenings experimenting in the kitchen. I love learning new techniques and trying out different recipes, especially when it comes to baking. While I enjoy my job, baking is my true passion. I'm single and live with my two cats, Muffin and Biscuit. I typically browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late at night. Besides baking, I have a keen interest in naval history and enjoy a good laugh, which is why I frequent joke subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have no formal culinary training, but I've spent countless hours watching baking shows and reading cookbooks. Most of my knowledge comes from hands-on experience and online communities where I've picked up tips and tricks from fellow baking aficionados. My interest in technology also allows me to explore innovative baking gadgets and techniques.
